_comment: Verified 7.0.255c -> 7.0.260c function mapping consumed by the 7.0.260c profile.
19 of 21 targets were unique masked-instruction consensus winners on the first
unpinned locate pass; all pins below re-verified by a second locate run.
songlist_asset_open ranked only WEAK between 0x165A000 and a multiplayer-tutorial
lookalike (0xBB8318) because 7.0.255c had inlined extra helpers into the 0x744-byte
body that live standalone again in 7.0.260c. Identity was settled by the
AAssetManager_open PLT stub (.AAssetManager_open @ 0x1A624D0) having exactly two
callers: sub_165A000 (call at +0x200 = 0x165A200, BL; MOV X20,X0; CBZ X0 pattern,
CCFileUtils-android.cpp strings) and the official integrity/preload path sub_1A49358.
registry_getter (0x20 bytes) is below port_match's voting floor; it was found by a
unique 24-byte tail pattern (CBZ/LDR/LDR/RET/MOV/RET) and confirmed by decompile:
expect_bytes can only cover the first word: the comparison always starts at the
pinned address, and word 1 (LDR X8,[X8,#lo12]) keeps a non-PC-relative imm12 that
changed because the global moved from page offset 0x028 to 0xDD0 - port_match's
mask deliberately leaves ordinary loads alone, so no prefix spanning word 1 can
ever pass. The 4 bytes are the pre-masked ADRP X8 word (0x90000008 both sides);
the pin's real evidence is the unique structural tail plus the decompile above.
